title: Settlement footprints
summary: Outlines of built-up areas, small settlements and hamlets, with an estimated building count for each.

temporal.note: GRID3 data year 2024; no exact date given

method: GRID3 v3.0 polygons kept where their representative interior point falls inside the pilot districts: 4,705 settlements.
limitations: Extents are modelled from imagery and contain false positives and omissions; they are not administrative boundaries.
Building counts cover the whole settlement, so they must never be reported as buildings flooded.
